description: This source file provides system information utilities, including checking long path support on Windows, determining OS architecture, and counting processors across different platforms.

classes.name: LongPathSupport
classes.description: Helper class to determine if long path support is enabled on Windows.

methods.name: IsLongPathsSupportEnabled
methods.description: Checks if long path support is enabled on Windows, using registry or ntdll.dll.

methods.name: OperatingSystemArchitecture
methods.description: Returns a string representing the system's architecture based on platform-specific calls.

methods.name: NumberOfProcessors
methods.description: Returns the number of logical processors available on the system.

methods.name: NumberOfPerformanceProcessors
methods.description: Returns the number of performance cores, especially on macOS ARM64 systems.
